entry_points.description: Constructs an Active hold with snapshots and calculated Money total from selected session inventory.
Read-only owner/state/time validation used by booking construction.
Converts a valid owned active hold before expiry.
Cancels an owned active hold before expiry.
Expires an active hold at or after its deadline.
Constructs a PendingPayment booking from valid hold snapshots without mutating the hold.
Confirms a pending booking strictly before its captured payment deadline; payment/seat validation remains Application responsibility.
Checks owner, cancellable state, and captured policy-derived cancellation deadline.
Expires a pending booking at or after its captured payment deadline.
Constructs a Pending payment from a PendingPayment booking, deriving Money amount/currency from its total.
Correlates a pending provider operation without changing its status.
Records success or ignores an identical already-succeeded result/reference.
Records failure or ignores an identical already-failed result/reference.
Registers the injectable system UTC clock for future application handlers.
